explicit_assumption_correction: The earlier no-skip restriction was stricter than a functional dependency: the vendor global git_submodule_check eagerly initializes every missing Gitlink before MINIMAL_BUILD and merely warns on wrong HEAD. Its absence is not proof of any used-source closure.
allowed_change: For one isolated configure only, command-local IDF_SKIP_CHECK_SUBMODULES=1 uses the existing documented internal-CI hook. Do not modify source or global environment. This skips generic acquisition/HEAD reconfigure tracking, not an external access or product acceptance gate.
experiment: Fresh isolated export of exact four frozen project inputs, same pinned SDK/toolchain/config; configure app and bootloader as the normal tool permits. Capture actual config, CMake component/file inputs and generated Ninja/compile descriptions before writing any new analyzer. Ordinary automatic compiler-identification probes are not product compile/link or variant proof.
required_evidence: Preflight exact top-level SDK source/tree and all Gitlink states including missing and wrong HEAD; no non-Gitlink SDK source edits
Actual command/complete stdout-stderr/exit and generated config/component/CMake/Ninja input formats
Resolve and strictly compare actually consumed submodule Gitlink and tracked file bytes to exact pinned objects; directory presence and vendor warning are insufficient
Include configure-time CMake/Kconfig/Python and both app/bootloader inputs; identify inputs not yet enumerable until dependency generation
Preserve skipped-check loss of automatic HEAD tracking; fresh configure and explicit source correspondence are required for any later admitted build
forbidden: No network acquisition/retry or URL/toolchain/source substitution
No product app/bootloader/variant build or physical flash/device/rail/fuse use
No claim all excluded modules unused before resolved proof
No claim configure success proves correct build, reproducibility, BOD polarity or hardware safety
stop: If configure fails, input provenance is wrong, an input cannot be resolved, or tool attempts external acquisition, stop dependent work and report exact missing property/source. Further build requires separate source-bound admission, not automatic continuation.
